item.title: Zoom Phone India Maintenance (Mumbai) : December 04, 2026
item.description:
THIS IS A SCHEDULED EVENT Dec 4, 04:00 PST  -  Dec 5, 10:00 PST

Nov 1, 21:28 PST
Scheduled - Zoom Phone users registered to the India (Mumbai) Data Center will be automatically registered in an alternative datacenter (Hyderabad) starting at 04th December 2026 04:00 AM PST (5:30 PM IST on 04th December 2026). During the maintenance window, a brief disconnection may be experienced and notifications may be missed. If you get disconnected, the system will attempt to reconnect you automatically.

If you are a BYOC (Bring Your Own Carrier) customer, please ensure that your Session Border Controller (SBC) is configured with alternate routing to alternate India (Hyderabad) Data Center in addition to the India (Mumbai) Data Center. During the maintenance window, connectivity to Zoom’s Mumbai Data Center will be blocked which will force calls from the Session Border Controller (SBC) to failover to Zoom’s India (Hyderabad) Data Center. Traffic will continue to be routed through the Zoom's India (Mumbai) Data Center once the maintenance is completed.

For customers that use hardware phones, refer to this link for the devices support the alternative datacenter process as described above: https://support.zoom.com/hc/en/article?id=zm_kb&sysparm_article=KB0061373#h_01GNZ783VT6YXHES8NSXBA5M9A

item.title: Zoom SSO Certificate Rotation 2026
item.description:
THIS IS A SCHEDULED EVENT Dec 1, 23:59 PST  -  Dec 2, 00:00 PST

Nov 9, 18:41 PST
Scheduled - Zoom will be making the new Service Provider certificate available on November 9, 2026, ahead of the expiration of the previously issued 2025/2026 certificate on Tuesday, December 1, 2026.

No action is required for customers using an identity provider (IDP) or configuration that supports dynamic metadata refresh, as your IDP will automatically download the latest Zoom certificate and rotate it into your account’s configuration starting Monday, November 9, 2026.

If automatic update is disabled or your IDP does not support automatic certificate rotation, your organization will need to manually rotate the certificate by December 1, 2026. If the certificate has not been rotated by then, your organization will be unable to utilize SSO services until the certificate has been updated.

For more information on rotating the SSO certificate, please see: https://support.zoom.com/hc/en/article?id=zm_kb&sysparm_article=KB0067680 .

Note: If the SP Certificate box is not on your SSO configuration page, no action is required to rotate to the new certificate.
